patches.game: Memories Off Pure (Neo Geo Pocket Color)
patches.notes:
**Memories Off Pure** is a 2000 Neo Geo Pocket Color visual novel by KID, released only in Japan. It is the prequel to Memories Off: Tomoya Mikami's middle-school days with his childhood friends Ayaka Hizuki and Yue Imasaka, and Ayaka's cousin Minamo Ibuki. It is the first Neo Geo Pocket Color game in this repository.

> **Please read:** this translation was made **entirely with AI**, as a personal project. It is shared as it is for anyone who wants to play. It must **never be uploaded to romhacking sites** (romhacking.net and the like): it isn't up to the standard of a real fan translation and doesn't belong there.

**How to patch**

Apply the .bps patch to *Memories Off - Pure (Japan).ngc* (No-Intro, 1 MB, CRC32 7F919DDE) with Floating IPS, beat or ROM Patcher JS. The result is 1 MB, CRC32 9FBC35F5. Keep the .ngc extension.

With Floating IPS on the command line:

    flips --apply "Memories.Off.-.Pure.EN.v0.9.1.bps" "Memories Off - Pure (Japan).ngc" "Memories Off - Pure (EN v0.9.1).ngc"

You must provide your own copy of the original Japanese game to apply it.

Save files from the Japanese game don't work with the patched game: start a new game.

**What is translated**

* The whole script: all three routes (Ayaka, Yue, Minamo), the scenes from Ayaka's and Yue's point of view, the choices, the endings and the staff roll.
* All menus: title menu, options, button config, save/load, CG mode, BGM mode, extras, character profiles and the attract-mode demo.
